frameworks.title: Assessing Risks & Applying a Risk-Based Approach
frameworks.summary: Measures to prevent or mitigate ML/TF must be commensurate with the risks identified.

frameworks.title: Money Laundering Offence & Detection Obligations
frameworks.summary: Financial institutions must maintain systems capable of detecting, investigating, and reporting suspicious activity.

frameworks.title: Targeted Financial Sanctions Related to Terrorism
frameworks.summary: Immediate asset freezing and prevention of funds/assets directly or indirectly available to sanctioned persons.

frameworks.title: Customer Due Diligence (CDD)
frameworks.summary: Mandates verifying customer identity, beneficial owners, and intended nature of business relationship.

frameworks.title: Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs)
frameworks.summary: Requires enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, and reasonable measures to establish source of wealth.

frameworks.title: Correspondent Banking & Third-Party Intermediaries
frameworks.summary: Gather sufficient information about respondent institutions and assess their AML/CFT controls.

frameworks.title: New Technologies & Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs)
frameworks.summary: VASPs must be licensed/registered and subject to effective AML/CFT systems including Travel Rule compliance.

frameworks.title: Wire Transfers (Travel Rule)
frameworks.summary: Requires originator and beneficiary information to accompany wire transfers throughout payment chain.

frameworks.title: Designated Non-Financial Businesses & Wealth Managers
frameworks.summary: CDD requirements apply when engaging in transactions for clients involving offshore holding entities.

frameworks.title: FCA Consumer Duty & Supervisory Expectations
frameworks.summary: Sets high standard of consumer protection, requiring firms to avoid causing foreseeable harm and prevent exploitation.

frameworks.title: Supervisory Framework for AI in Compliance Operations
frameworks.summary: Requires independent model validation, explainability, mandatory human sampling, and rollback plans for AI alert triage.

frameworks.title: Authorised Push Payment Fraud Mandatory Protections
frameworks.summary: Mandates 50:50 reimbursement liability between sending and receiving firms for APP fraud victims, driving strict real-time fraud scoring.

frameworks.title: Faster Payments Fraud Monitoring Standard
frameworks.summary: Mandates participating institutions to implement real-time scoring and delay protocols for suspect instant transfers.

frameworks.title: Markets in Crypto-Assets (CASP Authorisation)
frameworks.summary: Crypto-asset service providers must hold valid CASP authorization to operate or offer crypto wallets in the EU.

frameworks.title: AML/CFT Requirements for Registered Investment Advisers
frameworks.summary: Requires investment advisers to establish formal AML programs and report suspicious transactions under BSA.

frameworks.title: Third-Party Relationships: Risk Management
frameworks.summary: Comprehensive due diligence and continuous monitoring required for third-party payment processors and cross-border vendors.
